About.title: About
About.name: Kim Anna
bio:
Loves working not only with movement but also with the overall atmosphere of a project, blending music, ideas, and details into a single cohesive whole.

Special inspiration is found in the creative side of the process—searching for concepts, creating visual styles, and working on how to convey mood and emotions through movement.

Values the opportunity to share experience and see how people open up in dance and find their own style. It is important that everyone has space to grow and gain self-confidence.

Interested in various creative fields and loves trying new approaches, finding inspiration in music, visuals, and diverse ideas.

jobs.title: Choreographer, Performance Director, Dance Instructor, Founder & Leader of a Dance Team
jobs.description: Collaborated with artists and trainees, developed performance concepts and choreography, and trained backup dancers. Instructed students and prepared them for recitals, flash mobs, and competitions.
